title: pisum luteum
intro: Pisum luteum, commonly known as yellow garden pea or golden pea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used to support the reproductive system, and its health benefits include aiding in menstrual regulation, reducing symptoms of menopause, and promoting fertility. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic properties, which help to balance hormonal imbalances and alleviate symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The bioactive constituents of Pisum luteum include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
